configurations.name: StartExecution
configurations.description: Request a goodwill credit on a customer case. Use only after the customer has agreed to a credit. 'input' is a JSON string with caseId (string) and amountCents (integer, the amount in cents). 'name' must be credit-<caseId>-<yyyymmdd>. The workflow decides whether the credit is applied, needs a manager, or is refused; read the result with DescribeExecution.

parameterOverrides.description: credit-<caseId>-<yyyymmdd>. Starting twice with the same name does not credit twice.

configurations.name: DescribeExecution
configurations.description: Status and result of a goodwill credit request. Set includedData to ALL_DATA to read the outcome. RUNNING with no output means it is waiting for a manager.
